intro: Tutorial: tap a control to read what it does, or switch to Play to use BabbleBeat. On the FM-1 itself, holding GLO shows a guide like this on its own screen.
master: MASTER sets output volume in every page.
screen: The upper text is the current generated sentence. The waveform is a sentence-derived score; its moving playhead follows phoneme playback. The bottom labels follow the actual knob layout.

words.title: WORDS
keys: White keys: sixteen words, one a key (neighbouring nouns of the WORLD, which are kin). A key says a phrase about its word and keeps it; lower keys speak lower. Black keys: the word of the white key on their left in another kind of phrase, left to right: WHY?, NOT, WAS, IF, WILL, IS IT?, DID NOT, USED TO, BECAUSE, MAY, WHEN. A word moves a step now and then (WANDER); a phrase is made again now and then (DAMAGE).

KNOB1: How every phrase on the unit is built, in five levels: BARE (the mirror.), SIMPLE, PLAIN, JOINED, NESTED (the mirror that waits follows the signal when the static sings). Turned across a level, the phrase on the screen is built again and said; other keys follow when played.
KNOB2: How often a key's word moves when it is played: one step to the next word of its world. Also how loosely the words go together: low, verbs suit what they are about; high, anything goes with anything.
KNOB3: How often the word remembered with REC returns. Past 70 the phrases fix on it and loop back on themselves.
KNOB4: How often a key's phrase is made again as it is played. At 0 it stays until you change it; past 60 it may be broken instead: a word doubled, dropped, an "again".
SELECT: Where the keys' words come from. It starts on ALL: every world, about 6,800 nouns. Turn it to keep to one of twenty-one worlds, from MACHINE and GOTHIC to ANIMAL, FOOD, PERSON, MONEY. Turned into another, every key takes a new word from it.
ALGORITHM: The chance of a further clause, from PLAIN up.
PRESETS: Statement-only at low settings, mixed at centre, questions at high settings.

voice.title: VOICE
keys: White keys: sixteen words, one a key (neighbouring nouns of the WORLD, which are kin). A key says a phrase about its word and keeps it; lower keys speak lower. Black keys: the word of the white key on their left in another kind of phrase, left to right: WHY?, NOT, WAS, IF, WILL, IS IT?, DID NOT, USED TO, BECAUSE, MAY, WHEN. A word moves a step now and then (WANDER); a phrase is made again now and then (DAMAGE).

KNOB1: Base pitch for autonomously spoken phrases.
KNOB2: How fast it talks: about three times slower at the left, three times faster at the right.
KNOB3: A darker, larger voice to a brighter, smaller one.
ALGORITHM: Stutters. The start of a word is caught and played again, two to five times, before the word goes on: "th-th-the mirror". Higher: more often and choppier.
PRESETS: How much the pitch moves: a lift on each stressed syllable, a fall at the end, a rise for a question.

mouth.title: MOUTH
keys: White keys: sixteen words, one a key (neighbouring nouns of the WORLD, which are kin). A key says a phrase about its word and keeps it; lower keys speak lower. Black keys: the word of the white key on their left in another kind of phrase, left to right: WHY?, NOT, WAS, IF, WILL, IS IT?, DID NOT, USED TO, BECAUSE, MAY, WHEN. A word moves a step now and then (WANDER); a phrase is made again now and then (DAMAGE).

KNOB1: A small mouth, every resonance higher, to a large one.
KNOB2: Crisp, to sliding lazily from sound to sound.
KNOB3: The quiet between words: run together, to spaced out.

EDIT.label: WORDS
EDIT.text: Select the sentence engine's knobs. No hold required.

FX.label: VOICE
FX.text: Select the synthesizer's voice knobs. No hold required.

PLAY.label: BABBLE
PLAY.text: Babbles: one phrase after another about the word of the key last played. Press again, or HOME, to stop.

SEQ.label: NEW WORD
SEQ.text: Puts a new word on the key last played, and says a phrase about it.

ARP.label: CHANGE
ARP.text: Makes the phrase on the key last played again, about the same word, and says it.

REC.label: REMEMBER
REC.text: Remembers the word of the key last played. RECALL then brings it back into other phrases.

HOME.label: STOP
HOME.text: Stop speaking and turn off autoplay.

OCT-.label: VOICE DOWN
OCT-.text: The whole voice down an octave.

OCT+.label: VOICE UP
OCT+.text: The whole voice up an octave.

SAVE.unused: SAVE is not available: there is no saving yet.

GLO.label: GUIDE
GLO.text: Held down, the screen itself shows what every button does, laid out as the buttons are, with a line for the keys. Let go to return. Nothing else changes while it is held.

SEL.label: NEXT KNOBS
SEL.text: Steps through the three sets of knobs: VOICE, MOUTH, WORDS. MOUTH is reached only this way.
